summary.text: Josh Clark is the Republican candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 100 in the November 3, 2026 general election; the seat has no incumbent.
He previously served in the Georgia House of Representatives, representing District 98 from 2011 to 2015.

paragraphs.text: Clark was born in Atlanta, Georgia, according to Ballotpedia, which says his professional experience includes owning a nutraceutical distribution company and a real estate and management company.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised with nine siblings on a small farm in Suwanee, Georgia, and later took an executive role with NeoLife North America.

Clark won election to the Georgia House in 2010 and was unopposed in the 2012 general election; he served on committees including Health and Human Services, Appropriations and Natural Resources and Environment.

He ran for the U.S. Senate in the 2022 Republican primary, receiving 4.0 percent of the vote, and lost the 2024 Republican primary for Georgia State Senate District 49 to Drew Echols, 52.7 percent to 47.3 percent.
He won the May 19, 2026 Republican primary for District 100, defeating Edwin Duncan; his general-election opponent is Democrat Jennifer Ambler.
